title: MaldiSuite-paper: analysis code for the MaldiSuite paper
description:
Scripts, aggregated results and locked environments that produce the figures, tables and supplementary notes of the MaldiSuite paper: preprocessing of MALDI-TOF spectra, multi-site batch correction, deep-learning classification of antimicrobial resistance, and the train-test leakage and bin-width experiments on the DRIAMS cohort. The packages themselves live in their own repositories and on PyPI; the lock files pin the versions used for the paper (MaldiAMRKit 0.20.0, MaldiBatchKit 0.2.0, MaldiDeepKit 0.3.0). The DRIAMS spectra are not redistributed.

Funded by the European Union - NextGenerationEU, MUR PNRR Extended Partnership on Emerging Infectious Diseases (project PE00000007, INF-ACT).
